prompt:
Create pixel-art pieces for a modern 16-bit-style top-down RPG town map (three-quarter overhead view, like a classic SNES JRPG town).

Image 1 is a PLACEMENT GUIDE on a magenta page: draw each object inside its grey box, as described. Do not copy the grey colour.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: the approved walking sprite of a character from this game at the same pixel scale as the map (about 90 sprite pixels tall). Match its sprite-pixel size, its outlines and its flat 2-3 tone shading with light from the upper left.

Image 3 is approved art from this same game map: match its colours, outline weight and shading exactly.
Image 4 is approved art from this same game map: match its colours, outline weight and shading exactly.
Image 5 is approved art from this same game map: match its colours, outline weight and shading exactly.

Pieces:
- the top-left box (96x96 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). a tiny world-map icon of a walled town seen in three-quarter view: a low grey stone wall ring with a gate at the front and four small red-roofed houses inside.
- the top-centre box (96x96 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). a tiny world-map icon of a royal castle seen in three-quarter view: pale stone walls, two round towers with blue cone roofs and red flags, and a central keep with a gate at the front.
- the middle-left box (96x96 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). a tiny world-map icon of an ancient ruined temple seen in three-quarter view: dark weathered grey stone, broken columns, a crumbling roof and a dark doorway at the front, a little moss.
- the middle-centre box (48x48 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). a single small rocky mountain peak in grey-brown stone with a lit left face and a shadowed right face, filling the box.
- the middle-right box (48x48 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). a small clump of three round dark-green deciduous tree crowns seen from above at an angle, filling the box.
- the bottom-centre box (48x48 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). a mossy grey boulder, about half as wide as the box.

Draw each piece as one continuous picture with no lines dividing it into squares. Render as true pixel art: every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur. Between the boxes: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF), no text.
